Russia and China have hypersonic missiles. North Korea did a test a few days ago which was likely successful. Neither the US nor any European countries have hypersonic missiles.

The UK and France have nuclear armed submarines, but not many, and submarine fleets are exponentially more difficult to scale than hypersonic missiles.

There are no 'normal' people in europe want war with Russia. The heads of state of the three most significant European 'superpowers' currently have combined  national approval ratings lower than Nicholas Maduro's. And the EU is just a big lobby group run by people who weren't elected.

Best way to avoid war is to restore democracy and make politicians accountable.
